work_item: BODY-1 BB-CONTEXT JSON table inner-join explanation consumer and no-resend recovery
subject: MINIDORA language, meaning, judgment, execution and memory engine
purpose: An actual strict JSON-table inner join -> ordinary same-case ExplainPrevious -> exact sealed-input/report recomputation -> bounded two-sided source-span explanation -> local-file receipt recovery without resend

implementation.consumer: Recognizes the exact JSON inner-join report shape, admits SOURCE_REPORT only for the sealed JsonTableInnerJoin intent, loads that prior input bundle by actor/case/input/version, recomputes the typed join, and requires the canonical report bytes, sole prior report dependency, stored artifact and prior result text to match. It also revalidates the prior ContentPlan identity/text/guarantee, RenderObservation, their stored artifact bytes and the actual render hash. Matched rows are bounded to six; unmatched keys are bounded to four per side; every displayed source span is sliced from the sealed source and checked against its SHA-256.
implementation.core_route: The existing Core ExplainPrevious graph links the prior join result -> exact sealed InputBundle -> recomputed join report. Result dependencies are [prior result ID, input-bundle SHA-256, report-artifact SHA-256].
implementation.recovery_route: The existing local-file recovery verifier reconstructs the same explanation and dependency order before confirming the original authorized write. Recovery observations cover both the existing filter explanation and the new join explanation; bytes and modification times remain unchanged and the write is not resent.
stops: Duplicate keys remain a typed stop in the producer before a committed report is created.
Missing or mismatched sealed input, operation, canonical report, stored artifact, report text, ContentPlan, RenderObservation, source span, or dependency lineage suspends the explanation.
The bounded explanation returns RESOURCE_LIMIT when it exceeds the request evidence budget.

producer_consumer: Ordinary Japanese JSON-table inner-join request -> sealed JsonTableInnerJoin -> Core's unique-key exact string join -> committed SOURCE_REPORT artifact and rendered JSON -> ordinary same-case 詳しく説明して -> exact sealed-input and report revalidation -> paired source-row/cell and unmatched-key explanation -> Core content/render/history -> authorized local-file write -> recovery confirms the original bytes without resend.

normal_cli_route.observed: One actual Japanese CLI producer committed SOURCE_REPORT with two matches, one unmatched left row and one unmatched right row. ExplainPrevious committed a distinct rendered answer, mapped an output row to left source row 1 and right source row 3, showed both unmatched source rows and original byte ranges/hashes, and retained the exact dependency order [prior result, sealed input bundle, join report]. The execution graph records the sealed input as the report node's required evidence and the same input/report hashes as Core computation sources.
normal_cli_route.regressions: cargo test -p minidora-cli --test normal_route json_table_ --locked passed 6/6 scoped routes, including the new consumer, join source-range producer, filter/sort/select/project explanations, and JSON grouped-statistics routes. The duplicate-key stop regression passed separately.

recovery_route.observed: Fresh store reconciliation covered filter and join explanations. Both returned COMMIT/CONFIRMED with the original idempotency key; original target bytes and modification times were unchanged; each action had one write and was not resent.

command_results.result: Initial attempt exposed the old Computed-only explanation admission check; no feature change was accepted by that run. The check was corrected to admit SourceReport only for the exact sealed inner-join operation, then the command was rerun successfully.
Initial lint found a large enum variant after the join report was added. Boxing the report resolved the warning; the same command was rerun successfully.

asset_closure.rust_target: IN_USE and retained (2.6 GiB build/test cache)
asset_closure.test_temporary_directories: No matching json-table recovery fixture directories remained under /tmp after the tests.
asset_closure.downloaded_or_user_data: No new external source data or user data was downloaded or sent to providers.

requirements.B04: UNVERIFIED; this adds one JSON table join producer-consumer route only.
requirements.A07: UNVERIFIED; this is same-case prior-result lineage for one JSON table operation only.
requirements.A14: UNVERIFIED; this is one bounded explanation format, not general explanation/depth/format acceptance.

privacy_and_publication_audit.test_data: Synthetic table names and values only; no personal data or secrets added.
privacy_and_publication_audit.egress: No external provider request or data upload occurred.
privacy_and_publication_audit.scope: Repository source and evidence preservation only; no release, deployment, tag update or external communication.

limitations: Only strict JSON string-table inner joins use this new explanation path; CSV joins, table comparisons and other JSON operations remain separate consumers.
Explanation row/key counts are bounded and are not an exhaustive user-facing table rendering for oversized cases; the complete typed report remains retained as an artifact.
The route does not establish general language quality, semantic document interpretation, complete B04, A07, A14 or E08 acceptance, or overall MINIDORA successor completion.
